summary.text: Dan Ahlers is a Dell Rapids businessman and former state legislator who now leads the South Dakota Democratic Party. He was the party's 2020 U.S. Senate nominee. His campaign focuses on education, small business, family farms, health care access and cost of living.

paragraphs.text: Born in Dell Rapids; B.A. in government and international affairs from Augustana University (1997); opened the video-rental business Video Plus in 1999 and later owned a coffee house.
Served in the state House (2007–2009 and 2017–2019) and Senate (2009–2011) from District 25; lost the 2020 U.S. Senate race to Mike Rounds.
